marie_csm: Hi all — kickoff for Meridian Care onboarding. They9re going with Redwood Private in their AWS account for PHI. Target go-live: 7 weeks. Owners I propose: Marie (CSM), Adan (SE), Zoe (Ops), Luke (Enablement), Mira (PM). Add if missing.

marie_csm: Success criteria (draft): private endpoints + VPC peering green; SAML + SCIM working end-to-end; PHI schema mapping signed off; pilot latency p50 <300ms for 95% flows; runbook + training delivered to customer ops.

adan_se: I9ll own integration & test harness. Need sample payloads and SAML metadata from Mira9s contact. Will produce integration checklist by Fri.

zoe_ops: I9ll own VPC/network validation, security groups, certs. Q: expected pilot RPS? that drives pooling and batching.

mira_pm: Customer estimates ~40 RPS during pilot, ~180 RPS steady. I9ll confirm numbers and share contact details for SAML.

luke_enable: Enablement plan: two 75min sessions (dev + ops), quickstart doc, recording. I9ll draft dates and an initial slide deck.

marie_csm: Risks: delayed SAML metadata, missing PHI field mapping, cert/KMS provisioning taking longer than expected, outstanding legal/BAA items.

marie_csm: Actions: Marie request SAML + payload samples (Tue); Adan integration checklist (Fri); Zoe infra + autoscale draft (mid next week); Luke training schedule (Thu); Mira project board + customer contacts (today).

marie_csm: @onboardbot please schedule 60m kickoff with Meridian + internal owners next Wed 11am PT and paste invite here.

onboardbot: Meeting scheduled: Wed 11:00 AM PT  60m  "Meridian Care: Redwood Private Onboarding Kickoff" Join: https://meet.example.com/meridian (invites sent).

adan_se: :thumbsup: blocked.

luke_enable: +1 will prep agenda and slides."
